story.title: In Memory of My Wife, Elise Cawley, with Thanks for 36 Wonderful Years

draft:
Stephen Wolfram's tribute to his late wife Elise Cawley is a poignant reminder of the human side of tech. 
As I read his story, I'm struck by the intersection of personal and professional life. 
His work and legacy are deeply intertwined with his relationship. 
What role do you think personal relationships play in shaping our professional endeavors?
